text: それは　それは　にぎやかな　まちだそうです　オレも　いって　みたいなあ…

structure.jp: それは　それは　にぎやかな　まちだそうです
structure.en: I hear it's a very, very lively town

structure.jp: オレも　いって　みたいなあ…
structure.en: I'd like to try going too...

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (hearsay)
patterns.explanation: そうだ after a full plain statement means 'I hear that'. にぎやかな まちだそうです = 'I hear it's a lively town'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: て-form + みる means trying something to see what it's like; たい adds 'want to'. いって みたい = 'I'd like to try going'.
